learning_objective: 🎯 We will solve tricky number puzzles and find secret paths in our giant 100-grid!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sometimes numbers like to play hide and seek in the grid! We can look at the numbers next to an empty box to guess who is hiding there.
We can draw a path on the grid. If we step right, we add one. If we step down, we add ten. It is like a fun treasure hunt map for numbers!

fun_activity.title: 🎨 The Secret Number Game
fun_activity.instructions: Draw a small 3x3 square from a 100-grid but leave the middle box blank. Ask your friend to guess the secret missing number!

quick_recap: ⭐ The number grid helps us add and subtract by taking steps.
⭐ Looking at left, right, up, and down helps us find missing numbers fast!
